name: bm_go_board_useful
description: Reprofile Board.useful after warming a deeper real-game board state so neighbour.find() can mature into MWV before recompilation.
reprofile_warmup_expr: (lambda history=[to_pos(0,0), to_pos(1,0), to_pos(0,1), to_pos(2,0), to_pos(2,1), to_pos(1,2)], probe=to_pos(1,1), runs=50000: (lambda: (lambda board=Board(): (board.replay(history), all(map(board.useful, [probe] * runs))))()))()
